shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

for f in index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; echo "=== node_modules top"; ls node_modules | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; echo "=== node/npm"; node -v; npm -v

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -5 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -E '"(version|peerDependencies)"' -A4 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles 2>/dev/null

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; sed -n 1,80p $U/README.md; echo "=== peerDeps full"; node -e "const p=require('./$U/package.json');console.log(JSON.stringify({peer:p.peerDependencies,meta:p.peerDependenciesMeta,exports:Object.keys(p.exports||{})},null,1))"; echo "=== components"; ls $U/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo "=== PasswordInput props"; cat $U/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find $U/build/esm -name 'PasswordInput*.d.ts' | head; echo "=== TextInput props"; sed -n 1,80p $U/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; echo "=== ThemeProvider"; cat $U/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; echo "=== Checkbox"; cat $U/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo "=== Button"; sed -n 1,60p $U/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; echo "=== Card"; sed -n 1,40p $U/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo "=== Text"; sed -n 1,40p $U/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; echo "=== layout"; ls $U/build/esm/components/layout; echo "=== Flex"; sed -n 1,60p $U/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; echo "=== i18n"; cat $U/build/esm/i18n/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls $U/build/esm/i18n 2>/dev/null; echo "=== docs"; ls $U/docs 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,60p $U/docs/theming.md 2>/dev/null

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; echo "=== ControlProps"; grep -n "ControlProps" -A25 $U/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== Button types"; sed -n 1,80p $U/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts; echo "=== configure/i18n"; grep -rn "configure" $U/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat $U/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== Text variants"; grep -n "variant" -A3 $U/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn "TEXT_VARIANTS\s*=" -A30 $U/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.js 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== Box props"; sed -n 1,50p $U/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts; echo "=== spacing"; grep -n "spacing" $U/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; echo "=== configure export"; grep -rn "configure\|Lang" $U/build/esm/components/index.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/utils/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find $U/build/esm -name "configure*.d.ts" | head -3 | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "--- {}"; cat {}'; echo "=== BaseStyleProps"; grep -n "BaseStyleProps" -A40 $U/build/esm/components/layout/hooks/useStyleProps.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== PasswordInput keysets"; ls $U/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/i18n/ 2>/dev/null; cat $U/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; grep -n "configure\|utils" $U/build/esm/index.d.ts; grep -n "configure\|Lang" $U/build/esm/utils/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -n "width\|inlineSize\|maxWidth" $U/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts | head
sed -i -E 's/gap=\{([0-9]+)\}/gap="spacing-\1"/g' src/LoginPage.tsx && grep -n 'gap=' src/LoginPage.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome playwright 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>/dev/null) ; echo "--- gitignore"; cat .gitignore; echo "--- status"; git status --short
